_meta.method: complete direct literal rendering; source order preserved; no explanatory paraphrase

word_for_word: ततः किं वृत्तमित्यपेक्षायां संजय उवाच तं तथेति
when it is asked what happened next, Sañjaya spoke with ‘to him thus’
अश्रुभिः पूर्णे आकुले ईक्षणे यस्य तम्
to him whose eyes were filled with tears and agitated
तथोक्तप्रकारेण विषीदन्तमर्जुनं प्रति मधुसूदन इदं वाक्यमुवाच
to Arjuna grieving in the manner already stated, Madhusūdana spoke these words
तदेव वाक्यमाह श्रीभगवानुवाच कुत इति
he states those very words: the Blessed Lord said, with ‘whence’
कुतो हेतोः त्वा इति त्वाम्
‘whence’ means from what cause; ‘tvā’ means you
विषमे संकटे इदं कश्मलं समुपस्थितमयं मोहः प्राप्तः
in this difficult crisis, how has this impurity, this delusion, come upon you?
यत आर्यैरसेवितम्
it is not practiced by noble persons
अस्वर्ग्यमधर्म्यमयशस्करं च
it does not lead to heaven, is contrary to dharma, and causes ill fame
तस्मात् क्लैब्यमिति
therefore, with ‘unmanliness’
हे पार्थ क्लैब्यं कातर्यं मा स्म गमः न प्राप्नुहि
O Pārtha, do not fall into unmanliness, cowardice
यतस्त्वय्येतन्नोपपद्यते योग्यं न भवति
because this does not befit you; it is not appropriate
क्षुद्रं तुच्छं हृदयदौर्बल्यं कातर्यं त्यक्त्वा युद्धायोत्तिष्ठ
abandoning this petty, contemptible weakness of heart, this cowardice, rise for battle
हे परन्तप शत्रुतापन
O scorcher, afflicter of enemies
नाहं कातर्येण युद्धादुपरतोऽस्मि किंतु युद्धस्यान्याय्यत्वादित्यर्जुन उवाच कथमिति
Arjuna says with ‘how’: I have not withdrawn from battle through cowardice, but because battle is unjust
भीष्मद्रोणौ पूजायामर्हौ योग्यौ तौ प्रति कथमहं योत्स्यामि
Bhīṣma and Droṇa are worthy, fit, for worship; how shall I fight against them?
तत्रापीषुभिः
and that too with arrows
यत्र वाचापि योत्स्यामीति वक्तुमनुचितं तत्र बाणैः कथं योत्स्यामीत्यर्थः
where it is improper even to say with words ‘I shall fight them,’ how could I fight them with arrows? this is the meaning
हे अरिसूदन शत्रुसूदन
O destroyer of enemies
तर्हि तव देहयात्रापि न स्यादिति चेत्तत्राह गुरूनिति
if it is said, ‘then even maintenance of your body would not be possible,’ to this he says ‘the teachers’
गुरून्द्रोणादीनहत्वा परलोकविरुद्धो गुरुवधस्तमकृत्वा इह लोके भिक्षान्नमपि भोक्तुं श्रेयः उचितम्
without killing teachers such as Droṇa, without committing the killing of a teacher which obstructs the next world, it is better, proper, even to eat food obtained by begging in this world
विपक्षे तु न केवलं परत्र दुःखं इहैव तु नरकदुःखमनुभवेयमित्याह हत्वेति
on the contrary there would be misery not only hereafter but I would experience hellish misery here itself; he states this with ‘having killed’
गुरून्हत्वा इहैव तु रुधिरेण प्रदिग्धान्प्रकर्षेण लिप्तानर्थकामात्मकान्भोगानहं भुञ्जीय अश्नीयाम्
having killed the teachers, here itself I would eat enjoyments consisting of wealth and desire, thoroughly smeared with blood
यद्वा अर्थकामानिति गुरूणां विशेषणम्
or ‘desiring wealth’ qualifies the teachers
अर्थतृष्णाकुलत्वादेते तावद्युद्धान्न निवर्तेरन् तस्मादेतद्वधः प्रसज्येतैवेत्यर्थः
because they are overwhelmed by thirst for wealth, they will not withdraw from battle; therefore their killing would necessarily follow—this is the meaning
तथाच युधिष्ठिरं प्रति भीष्मेणोक्तम् अर्थस्य पुरुषो दासो दासस्त्वर्थो न कस्यचित् इति सत्यं महाराज बद्धोऽस्म्यर्थेन कौरवैः इति
thus Bhīṣma said to Yudhiṣṭhira: ‘man is the slave of wealth, but wealth is no one’s slave; this is true, O king; through wealth I am bound to the Kauravas’
किंच यद्यप्यधर्ममङ्गीकरिष्यामस्तथाऽपि किमस्माकं जयः पराजयो वा भवेदिति न ज्ञायत इत्याह नचेति
and further, even if we accept adharma, it is not known whether victory or defeat would be ours; he says this with ‘nor do we know’
एतद्द्वयोर्मध्ये नोऽस्माकं कतरत् किं नाम गरीयोऽधिकतरं भविष्यतीति न विद्मः
between these two, we do not know which would be weightier, better, for us
तदेव द्वयं दर्शयति यद्वा एतान्वयं जयेम जेष्यामः यदि वा नोऽस्मानेते जयेयुर्जेष्यन्तीति
he shows those two alternatives: whether we should conquer them, or whether they should conquer us
किं चास्माकं वा जयोऽपि फलतः पराजय एवेत्याह
and further, even our victory would in result be defeat; he says this
यानेव हत्वा जीवितुं नेच्छामस्त एवैते संमुखेऽवस्थिताः
those very persons after killing whom we would not wish to live are standing before us
कार्पण्येति
with ‘by the fault of helplessness’
तस्मात्कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः
therefore my nature is struck by the fault of helplessness
एतान्हत्वा कथं जीविष्याम इति कार्पण्यं दोषश्च स्वकुलक्षयकृतः
helplessness is the thought ‘having killed them, how shall we live?’ and the fault is that produced by destruction of one’s own family
ताभ्यामुपहतोऽभिभूतः स्वभावः शौर्यादिलक्षणो यस्य सोऽहं त्वां पृच्छामि
I whose nature, characterized by valor and the like, is struck and overpowered by those two ask You
तथा धर्मे संमूढं चेतो यस्य सः
likewise, one whose mind is confused regarding dharma
युद्धं त्यक्त्वा भिक्षाटनमपि क्षत्रियस्य धर्मो वाऽधर्मो वेति संदिग्धचित्तः सन्नित्यर्थः
that is, being doubtful whether for a kṣatriya abandoning battle and living by begging is dharma or adharma
अतो मे यन्निश्चितं श्रेयो युक्तं स्यात्तद्ब्रूहि
therefore tell me what is definitely good and proper for me
किंच तेऽहं शिष्यः शासनार्हः
and further I am Your disciple, fit to be instructed
अतस्त्वां प्रपन्नं शरणागतं मां शाधि शिक्षय
therefore instruct, teach, me who have taken refuge in You
त्वमेव विचार्य यद्युक्तं तत्कुर्विति चेत्तत्राह नहीति
if it is said ‘consider for yourself and do what is proper,’ to this he says ‘I do not’
इन्द्रियाणामुच्छोषणमतिशोषणकरं मदीयं शोकं यत्कर्मापनुद्यादपनयेत्तदहं न प्रपश्यामि
I do not see any action that would remove my grief which dries up, exceedingly dries up, my senses
यद्यपि भूमौ निष्कण्टकं समृद्धं राज्यं प्राप्स्यामि
even if I were to obtain a prosperous kingdom on earth without rivals
तथा सुरेन्द्रत्वमपि यदि प्राप्स्यामि
and even if I were to obtain lordship over the gods
एवमभीष्टं तत्सर्वमवाप्यापि शोकापनोदनोपायं न प्रपश्यामीत्यन्वयः
even after obtaining everything desired in this way, I do not see a means of removing this grief—such is the construction
एवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः किं कृतवानित्यपेक्षायां संजय उवाच
when it is asked what Arjuna did after speaking thus, Sañjaya spoke
एवमिति स्पष्टार्थः
‘thus’—the meaning is clear
ततः किं वृत्तमित्यपेक्षायामाह तमुवाचेति
when it is asked what happened then, he says ‘he spoke to him’
प्रहसन्निव प्रसन्नमुखः सन्नित्यर्थः
‘as if smiling’ means with a cheerful face
देहात्मनोरविवेकादस्यैवं शोको भवतीति तद्विवेकप्रदर्शनार्थं श्रीभगवानुवाच अशोच्यानिति
because this grief arises from non-discrimination between body and Self, the Blessed Lord speaks ‘those not to be grieved for’ in order to show their distinction
शोकस्याविषयभूतानेव बन्धूंस्त्वमन्वशोचः अनुशोचितवानसि दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम् इत्यादिना
you grieved for relatives who are not proper objects of grief, saying ‘seeing these kinsmen, O Kṛṣṇa, assembled desiring to fight’ and so forth
तत्र कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम् इत्यादिना मया बोधितोऽपि
although instructed by Me with ‘whence has this impurity come upon you in this crisis?’ and so forth
पुनश्च प्रज्ञावतां पण्डितानां वादान् शब्दान्कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये इत्यादीन्केवलं भाषसे नतु पण्डितोऽसि
again you merely speak words, statements, of those possessing wisdom, the learned, such as ‘how shall I fight Bhīṣma in battle?’ but you are not learned
यतो गतासून्गतप्राणान्बन्धूनगतासूंश्च जीवतोऽपि बन्धुहीना एते कथं जीविष्यन्तीति नानुशोचन्ति
for the learned do not grieve for relatives whose life-breaths have departed, nor for the living with the thought ‘bereft of relatives, how will they live?’
अशोच्यत्वे हेतुमाह नत्वेवेति
he states the reason they are not to be grieved for with ‘never indeed’
यथाऽहं परमेश्वरो जातु कदाचिल्लीलाविग्रहस्याविर्भावे तिरोभावेऽपि नासमिति नैव अपितु आसमेव अनादित्वात्
just as it is never the case that I, the Supreme Lord, did not exist at any time, even when My sport-form manifests or disappears; rather I always existed because I am beginningless
नच त्वं नासीः नाभूः अपित्वासीरेव
nor is it that you did not exist; rather you certainly existed
इमेच जनाधिपाः नृपाः नासन्निति न अपितु आसन्नेव मदंशत्वात्
nor is it that these rulers, these kings, did not exist; rather they certainly existed, being portions of Me
तथाऽतःपरं इतउपर्यपि न भविष्यामो न स्थास्याम इति च नैव अपितु स्थास्याम एव
likewise, hereafter it is not that we shall not exist or remain; rather we shall certainly remain
जन्ममरणशून्यत्वादशोच्या इत्यर्थः
because they are devoid of birth and death, they are not to be grieved for; this is the meaning
